description:
Spawn isolated subagents for parallel or context-heavy work. Each has its own conversation, terminal session and toolset; only its final summary returns to you.

Sessions without a later-result consumer (including one-shot CLI and cron) join parallel children and return results in this tool call. Otherwise runs in the background: dispatch returns live transcript paths and results re-enter as a new message when subagents finish (one message per call). Background results are delivered only BETWEEN your turns: finish whatever does not depend on them, then give a one-line status and END YOUR TURN. Never wait or poll on transcripts, artifact files, or CI for a child. While children run, `action` (list/steer/stop) controls them live.

Use for reasoning-heavy subtasks, work that would flood your context, or independent parallel workstreams.
Do not use for:
- Mechanical multi-step work needing no reasoning -> execute_code
- A single tool call -> call the tool directly
- Tasks needing user interaction: subagents cannot ask questions
- Durable work that must survive this session -> cronjob or terminal(background=True, notify=True). /stop, /new or process exit halts running subagents (whole tree); each returns an 'interrupted' completion with partial output.

Rules:
- Children know nothing of this conversation: pass everything needed via 'context', including any required output language, tone or style.
- Child summaries are self-reports, not verified facts. For external side effects (uploads, remote writes, publishing), require a verifiable handle (URL, ID, absolute path) and verify it yourself before telling the user it succeeded.
- Children cannot close tracked work: a child asked to close it returns findings and the parent applies the transition.
- Children cannot call delegate_task, clarify, memory, or cronjob.
- Children inherit the parent model unless pinned via delegation.provider / delegation.model in config.yaml.
name: delegate_task

action.description: Default 'spawn'. The others control running children live, return immediately and ignore tasks: 'list' = ids/goals/status/transcripts; 'steer' = queue course-correction text into one child without stopping it (subagent_id + message); 'stop' = end one child early (subagent_id; partial result still returns).

message.description: For 'steer': the course correction, appended to the child's next tool result mid-run. Be directive and specific.

subagent_id.description: Target of 'steer'/'stop'; ids come from the spawn response or 'list'.

tasks.description: Every task to spawn: up to 10 in parallel for this user (set via delegation.max_concurrent_children), one subagent per entry; a single task is a one-entry array. Required when spawning.

context.description: Background this child needs: file paths, error messages, constraints. Each child sees only its own context: repeat shared background in every task that needs it.

goal.description: What this subagent should accomplish; specific and self-contained (it knows nothing of your conversation).

images.description: Images this child must see (max 8): local file paths or http(s) URLs. Vision-capable children receive the pixels on their first turn; others get path hints for vision_analyze. Text files do NOT belong here: put their paths in 'context'.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema the child's final answer must validate against (the child is told up front; the parent validates, with one bounded correction retry). The result gains schema_valid, plus schema_errors on failure; the child's raw text is still returned as summary. Keep it forgiving: require only fields you will read.
